character: A Vishkanya man of thirty-five, lean and precise, with fine jewel-toned scaling over his skin that has gone dull and ashen at the temples; a narrow, courteous, intelligent face built for good manners; dark hair swept back; clean-shaven with no trace of stubble. His eyes carry a faint cold luminescence, as though catching a light that is not in the room. He looks tired in a way that sleep would not fix
wardrobe: an excellent unshowy merchant's coat of dark green wool over a high-collared shirt, well cut and a year out of fashion, worn indoors as though he is always slightly cold; no jewellery except a plain wooden ring

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, three-quarter view, calm and composed, hands loosely at his sides.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, facing the viewer, faintly luminous eyes, courteous and hollow.

scene.framing: Seated on a white iron bench in a humid glass conservatory crowded with overgrown green plants, an open untitled book in his lap, looking up with a warm welcoming smile as though he has been expecting you.
